geo.geo_note:
Origin: top-left corner. X → right. Y ↓ down (toward foot of bed).
Yaw = angle of radar forward axis from Y-axis, clockwise positive.
Pitch/Roll: 0 for horizontal mount; enter tilt angle or read from IMU.
geo.poly_hint_none: Click canvas to draw boundary (≥ 3 points)
geo.boundary_note: No boundary = no filtering. Targets outside the polygon are ignored.
geo.place_the_radar_in_the_room: Place the radar in the room
geo.drag_the_colored_handles_to_set: Drag the colored handles to set position, height and orientation.
geo.click_the_top_down_map_to: Click the top-down map to outline the active detection area.
geo.click_the_map_to_add_the: Click the map to add the first point

yaw.ref_a_idle: Click the preview to mark a known position
yaw.ref_a_marked: Marked at ({x}, {y}) cm — walk there, then Capture
yaw.ref_b_step: Click another known position (> 80 cm from A)
yaw.ref_b_marked: Marked at ({x}, {y}) cm — walk there, then Capture
yaw.capture_btn: Walk to marked position → Capture radar reading
yaw.result_idle: Click the preview map to start — mark reference point A
yaw.choose_two_well_separated_places_you: Choose two well-separated places you can stand, then capture one reading at each.
yaw.click_the_map_to_choose_where: Click the map to choose where to stand
yaw.stand_still_while_waiting_for_radar: Stand still while waiting for radar data…
yaw.choose_a_position_on_the_map: Choose a position on the map first
yaw.troubleshoot_title: If the live point looks wrong
yaw.troubleshoot_body: Mirrored motion means yaw is 180° off. Motion at right angles means 90° off. Recapture the two points rather than editing the number by hand. 2D radars cannot infer pitch or roll from floor points.

live.title: Room Top-Down View
live.walk_through_the_room_and_confirm: Walk through the room and confirm that target positions and trails match reality.

area.hint: Stand at the desk, bed or door and tap I'm here — or click the map to draw the polygon yourself.
area.stand_need_target: Walk into the spot first. The radar needs a target before it can place the area.
area.warn_small: An area is narrower than {cm} cm — occupancy may flicker.
area.warn_close: Area centroids are closer than {cm} cm — exclusive assignment will fight.
area.warn_overlap: Areas overlap. A still target stays in the last area until it leaves the hysteresis band.

editor.all_calibrations_were_applied_and_saved: All calibrations were applied and saved.
editor.place_multiple_2_d_radars_in: Place multiple 2-D radars in one floor-plan coordinate system and sync them to the persistent HA backend.
editor.sync_configuration_to_the_backend_when: Sync configuration to the backend when an administrator opens the card
editor.only_radar_models_with_2_d: Only radar models with 2-D or 3-D positions are shown. Every radar needs a unique ID.
editor.configure_devices_then_place_them: Use tabs to add, remove and bind radar devices. Adjust installation and direction from the card’s top-right calibration workspace.
editor.select_a_radar_in_the_shared: Select a radar in the shared room model, then drag the handles to adjust its position, height and orientation. Other radars remain as gray landmarks.
editor.current_tab_controls_form_and_3d: The active tab keeps its parameter form and 3-D model in sync. Other radars remain as gray landmarks.
editor.each_shared_reference_position_captures_: Each shared reference position captures every radar and independently solves yaw and X/Y corrections for each device.
editor.filter_single_radar_false_alarms_and: Filter single-radar false alarms and save recordings only for complete, continuous crossings after a track ends.
editor.duplicate_gate_cm_help: Extra slots from one radar closer than this are treated as the same person.
editor.range_merge_factor_help: Extra merge allowance as a fraction of radar-local range. 0.08 at 5 m adds 40 cm.
editor.merge_confirm_s_help: How long two close confirmed tracks must overlap before they become one identity.
editor.enter_near_one_room_edge_walk: Enter near one room edge, walk continuously for at least {p0} cm, and leave at another edge. Wait {p1} seconds after leaving radar coverage. A qualified event becomes TRAVERSE and triggers the camera.
editor.draw_polygon_vertices_on_the_floor: Draw lobby, corridor or stairwell zones on the floor plan. Indoor bathrooms and desks use single-radar Occupied, not fusion. Saved zones sync to the backend.
editor.cameras_help: Stills and short clips are saved locally when those events fire. This does not search an NVR timeline. Leave zones unchecked to record every zone.
editor.camera_zones_all: No zones drawn yet — this camera records the whole floor.
editor.choose_a_radar_device_to_match: Choose a radar device to match entities automatically, then confirm the room size.
editor.select_the_radar_from_home_assistant: Select the radar from Home Assistant and the card will identify the required entities.
editor.automatic_detection_failed_configure_ent: Automatic detection failed. Configure entities manually below.
editor.enter_the_room_dimensions_used_by: Enter the room dimensions used by the 3D placement and target map.
editor.fusion_rate_hz_help: How often positions are computed. Higher is smoother and costs more CPU. It does not change how much is stored — that is the trajectory quality setting persist_interval_s, which saves one position per track every half second by default.
editor.association_distance_cm_help: How far a target may move between frames and still be treated as the same person. Too small splits one person into several tracks; too large merges two people into one.
editor.confirm_hits: Frames before a track is published
editor.confirm_hits_help: Raising this suppresses brief false targets at the cost of a slower first detection.

card.place_the_radar_in_the_3d: Place the radar in the 3D room
card.calibrate_yaw_with_two_reference_points: Calibrate direction with samples from several areas
card.no_playable_clip_is_available_yet: No playable clip is available yet, or recording is still in progress.

fusion.event_search_hint: Filter by type, zone and time. Thumbnails are local stills, not NVR playback.
fusion.integration_missing_help: Multi-radar fusion needs the separate mmwave-fusion integration (experimental). Without it the card fuses in the browser only: no stored trajectories, no events, no recordings.
fusion.heatmap_needs_newer_backend: The heatmap needs a newer mmwave-fusion integration
fusion.heatmap_hint: Where people walked. Apartment: which stretch of corridor is used. Does not name anyone.
fusion.replay_empty: Nothing was recorded in this window
fusion.replay_needs_newer_backend: Replay needs a newer mmwave-fusion integration
fusion.replay_hint: What happened at a time. Apartment: check a 3am crossing without a camera.
fusion.assist_hint: Optional: enable the MMWave Fusion LLM API on a conversation agent to ask Assist about occupancy and events. Radar tracks stay anonymous.
fusion.calibration_hint_not_reporting: Not reporting. Check power, Wi-Fi and the UART wiring first.
fusion.calibration_hint_stale_frames: The ESP is reachable but frames have stopped. A full power cycle usually fixes this.
fusion.calibration_hint_outside_room: Fewer than 20% of detections land inside the room. Yaw is usually 90° or 180° off, or the origin corner is wrong. Recalibrate from the yaw tab; do not edit numbers by hand.

workflow.editor_calibration_title: Installation and calibration are on the card
workflow.editor_calibration_hint: Save the basic configuration, return to the card and open its top-right calibration control for placement, direction and live verification. Selecting a profile here only binds it.
workflow.discard_confirm: Leave and discard unapplied installation changes and capture samples?
workflow.preview_readonly: Save and exit the card editor, then open calibration from the card’s top-right control.
workflow.backend_required: Update and connect the fusion backend before calibrating multiple radars.
workflow.verify_hint: This temporary fusion preview uses your draft installation. Walk through the room alone and check target merging and continuity, then apply and sync. This preview stores no tracks or recordings; the running backend continues using its saved settings.
workflow.saved: Calibration saved in HA and synced to all devices.
workflow.saved_partial: Calibration saved in HA. Some device parameters could not be synced; reconnect and retry.
workflow.save_failed: Calibration could not be applied. Check the error; if another page updated calibration, exit and reopen this workspace.
workflow.draft_hint: Apply after verification; exit to discard changes

fusioncal.no_radar_produced_enough_stable_samples: No radar produced enough stable samples. Try again.
fusioncal.keep_only_one_test_person_in: Keep one person in the room. Follow the green areas and stand still to capture; centimetre accuracy is unnecessary.
fusioncal.mobile_calibration_hint: Use the focused view to keep guidance and capture controls visible.
fusioncal.click_the_floor_plan_to_choose: Click the floor plan to choose the next reference position
fusioncal.tap_a_guided_region: Tap one of the guided capture areas.
fusioncal.stand_near_center_then_hold_still: Stand approximately near the center, within about one small step. Captured: {p2}/{p3} radars.
fusioncal.tap_another_region_or_follow_recommendat: Follow the green guide; tap empty space to move the current uncaptured area.
fusioncal.region_p0_captured_p1_p2_radars: Area {p0} captured {p1}/{p2} radars. The next area is now recommended.
fusioncal.capturing_p0_percent_p1_p2_radars_ready: Capturing {p0}% · {p1}/{p2} radars have stable samples. Hold still.
fusioncal.review_p0_radars_before_retrying: {p0} need more valid samples. Capture another visible area; completed readings are retained.
fusioncal.xy_yaw_only_manual_note: Joint calibration estimates only X, Y and yaw. Confirm radar_z, pitch and roll from the physical installation. A rejected fit is diagnostic only and is never written to the configuration.
fusioncal.quality_not_enough_points: Only {p0} valid points; this reference has low confidence.
fusioncal.quality_span_too_small: The capture span is only {p0} cm; this reference has low confidence.
fusioncal.quality_residual_too_high: The fitted residual of {p0} cm exceeds {p1} cm. Check the installation and outlier captures first; do not copy this reference directly.
fusioncal.quality_reference_outside_room: The fitted installation is outside the room. Check the coordinate origin, direction and physical installation.
fusioncal.quality_reference_accepted: The fitted residual is {p0} cm; this reference can be reviewed or applied.
fusioncal.need_3_points_120_cm_span: Capture at least three separated areas
fusioncal.retained_current: Existing parameters passed this check; no adjustment needed.
fusioncal.ready_summary: Capture complete: {p0} ready to verify; {p1} need more samples and will keep their existing settings.
fusioncal.range_only: Range-only radar cannot determine direction. Set its orientation in Installation.
fusioncal.remove_before_moving: Remove this captured area in details before moving it.
fusioncal.outlier_remaining: A large mismatch remains. Capture another area.
fusioncal.retained_names: {p0}: existing parameters passed this check; no adjustment needed.
fusioncal.pending_names: {p0} still need calibration. Their existing settings are retained; capture more areas later.
fusioncal.standing_area_outside: Choose a standing area inside the boundary and away from walls.
fusioncal.no_standing_area: No usable standing area. Check the room boundary, dimensions and radar placement.
fusioncal.few_standing_areas: Too little space for three separate standing areas. Check the boundary and radar placement.

zone.at_least_three_vertices_are_required: At least three vertices are required
zone.name: Name
zone.dwell_seconds_help: 0 = no dwell event. Apartment loitering: 300 for five minutes. Indoor bathrooms use single-radar Occupied, not this.
zone.select_or_create_a_zone_then: Select or create a zone, then click its vertices on the floor plan.

install3d.vertical_fov_is_not_specified_showing: Vertical FOV is not specified; showing a conservative estimate
install3d.nominal_scan_volume_from_the_model: Nominal scan volume from the model manual
install3d.drag_the_colored_handles_to_position: Drag the colored handles to position and orient the radar

range.title: Distance filter
range.explanation: This radar measures range only. Position on the centre line is illustrative; polygon filtering is unavailable.
range.zero: 0 disables that software limit. Changes are sent with Sync to device.
range.native_min_unknown: Native minimum and per-gate exclusions are not reported here; full coverage is not verified.
range.limited: Native maximum is smaller than the software interval; targets beyond it cannot be recovered.
range.noise_preserved: Native detection thresholds are preserved; changing this interval does not reset them.
range.noise_unknown: Adjustable native noise rejection is not confirmed for this model; no noise parameters are overwritten.
range.invalid: Maximum distance must be zero or at least the minimum distance.

floorplan.title: Floor plan background
floorplan.source_hint: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP image, for example /local/floorplans/room.png in HA.
floorplan.error: Unable to load image. Check the URL.
floorplan.unlock_hint: Unlock to adjust image placement and scale.
floorplan.drag_hint: Drag the image to align it. The green outline is the room.
floorplan.scale_hint: Tap both ends of a known wall segment, then enter its actual length.
floorplan.origin_hint: Tap the image point that should be the room origin.
floorplan.upload_error: Upload failed. Choose a PNG, JPEG or GIF under 9 MB and check the HA connection.
floorplan.trace_hint: Tap near wall corners to trace; undo to correct a point.
floorplan.trace_unavailable: Use an uploaded image for snapping; manual tracing is still available.
